premises.text: People manage digital life through dozens of apps and constant phone checks instead of a less disruptive interface
premises.evidence_span: There should be a nicer way to communicate with technology rather than checking your phone every single minute

premises.text: Glance Clock is a wall clock with glanceable geometric display, speaker, and open cloud integrations that shows relevant wearable, device, and web data by place and situation
premises.evidence_span: Glance Clock is a well-designed wall clock with embedded glanceable display, built-in speaker, and open cloud platform

premises.text: Go-to-market launches via Indiegogo at about $149, then web pre-orders and retail, with personalizable frames
premises.evidence_span: we will launch Indiegogo campaign on February this year

value.text: Reading needed information at a glance without disrupting current tasks
value.evidence_span: read information quickly at a glance without being disrupted from your current tasks

causal_links.evidence_span: checking your phone every single minute
shows you information from your wearables, connected devices, and web services right at the moment you need it
the estimated price will be just $149 for a single device

notes: Sleep/weather/calendar demo integrations and location-relevant multi-clock behavior folded as cascade of one clock+cloud mechanism (§4.1.7). Team bios and community size excluded. Anti-template: overload problem, product, and crowdfunding/retail GTM are separately revisable.
